create_DISTS_model: create a DISTS perceptual similarity model using pretrained VGG16 features for image comparison
run_DISTS_score: run the DISTS model to compute perceptual similarity score between two reference and distorted images
build_L2pooling_layer: build an L2 pooling layer with Hanning window filter for feature extraction in the DISTS network
prepare_image_for_DISTS: prepare a PIL image by resizing and converting to tensor for DISTS model input
test_DISTS_cli: test the DISTS module via CLI with --ref and --dist image arguments to print similarity score
